answer: AI agents routing cargo between mountain summit depots, coastal wharf docks, and shale basins resist Sybil attacks using proof of space. To register, an agent must commit unique cryptographic plot tables to storage drives and solve random retrieval challenges, forcing attackers to dedicate scarce physical disk capacity per fabricated identity. A key limitation is that adversaries with bulk access to commodity storage arrays can amortize hardware costs to generate identities in volume.
